# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 39 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** God Commands Michael to Guard Adam

---

**1** God commanded Michael: 'Guard the body of Adam until the day of the resurrection.'

**2** Michael said: 'Lord, your will be done. I will guard him as you command.'

**3** Michael placed Adam's body in a place of honor and set angelic guards over it.

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
